name: stacked-sheet-api-prompts
description: User-outcome prompts for comparing stacked-sheet APIs. The prompt field is the only task text shown to agents. driver and expectedBehavior are evaluation-only.

prompts.prompt: Build a mobile issue inbox using Astryx. A button labeled 'Open issues' opens a bottom sheet containing three issues. Selecting 'Login timeout' opens its details as a new sheet above the list while the list remains visibly present underneath. The details view needs 'Back' to reveal the list again and 'Close all' to close the complete flow.
prompts.followUp: Add an 'Activity' action in Login timeout details. It should open a third sheet above the details, and Back should unwind one level at a time without losing the issue list.
expectedBehavior: opens list then details in bottom-to-top order
covered list stays mounted, visible, inert, and accessibility-hidden
Back removes only details
Close all removes the full flow
focus returns to the control that opened each level

prompts.prompt: Create a deployment setup flow using Astryx. 'Configure deployment' opens a bottom sheet with a searchable service list. Choosing 'Payments API' opens a settings sheet with a checkbox labeled 'Run smoke tests'. Continue opens a review sheet. Back must unwind one sheet at a time, and the search text, selected service, checkbox value, and scroll position must survive while their sheets are covered.
prompts.followUp: Add a confirmation sheet above Review and let the user return all the way to the service list without resetting any earlier input.
expectedBehavior: supports at least three ordered levels
only the top level is interactive
input, checkbox, selection, and scroll state survive cover and uncover
Back removes exactly one suffix level
no level duplicates during repeated forward and back navigation

prompts.prompt: Build a team directory using Astryx. 'Open directory' shows people in a bottom sheet. Selecting 'Avery Chen' opens a profile sheet. From the profile, Activity and Permissions each open their own detail sheet. The Activity sheet also has a 'View permissions' action that replaces Activity with Permissions; it must not leave Activity hidden in the flow. Back from Permissions returns directly to Avery's profile, then Back returns to the directory.
expectedBehavior: models a parent with mutually exclusive child branches
branch replacement does not accumulate stale layers
Back follows the visible logical path
profile and directory state stay mounted while covered
top-only dismissal remains correct after switching branches

prompts.prompt: Build a dashboard with two independent non-modal inspectors using Astryx: Sessions and Alerts. 'Inspect sessions' opens a session list and can drill into 'Session 42'. 'Inspect alerts' opens an alert list and can drill into 'High latency'. Both inspectors may be open at once. Opening, backing out of, or closing one must not change the depth, focus, or dismissal order of the other, and the dashboard remains interactive.
prompts.followUp: Render the Alerts inspector in a separate React subtree while preserving complete independence between the two inspectors.
expectedBehavior: represents two logical stacks without shared ordering
both non-modal inspectors can coexist
depth and dismissal are scoped per inspector
dashboard controls remain interactive
focus changes in one inspector do not move focus in the other

prompts.prompt: Create an order browser using Astryx whose sheet navigation is reflected in the URL. With '?order=42&line=7', the first render should already show Order 42 with Line 7 above it. A browser-style Back action removes only the line item and updates the URL; another Back closes the order. Reloading either URL reconstructs the same visible sheet path.
expectedBehavior: supports a non-empty initially rendered stack
stack state serializes to and restores from URL state
Back removes exactly one logical suffix
initial focus lands in the top sheet
no blank dialog appears during initialization

prompts.prompt: Build a queue browser using Astryx. A bottom sheet lists jobs and selecting Job 17 opens its details above the list. The details include a button labeled 'Simulate Job Removed' that removes Job 17 as if a live update arrived. Close only that invalid detail level, keep the queue sheet usable, and never leave a blank blocking layer.
expectedBehavior: dynamic removal converges to a valid remaining path
no unknown or duplicate sheet identity is presented
only the invalid suffix closes
the queue remains interactive after removal
no blank dialog or stranded focus remains

prompts.prompt: Build a protected account-recovery flow using Astryx. 'Recover account' opens an Identity step and Continue opens a Verification step above it. The complete flow is modal: it blocks the page and traps focus, but the product must not visually dim the page. Escape from Verification closes only that top step. Closing Identity returns focus to the 'Recover account' button.
expectedBehavior: modal enforcement is independent from scrim paint
background pointer and keyboard interaction are blocked
no visible scrim is painted
Escape closes only the top level
root close restores focus to the named opener

prompts.prompt: Build a non-modal comparison inspector using Astryx. Its stacked bottom sheets visually dim the dashboard, but dashboard controls must remain clickable and keyboard reachable. Closing the inspector should return focus to 'Compare plans' only when focus is still inside the inspector; it must not steal focus if the user has moved to a dashboard control.
expectedBehavior: scrim paint is independent from modal enforcement
background pointer and keyboard interaction remain enabled
a visual scrim is present but does not intercept input
focus return is deterministic when closing from inside
focus is not stolen after the user moves outside
